class.name: DSPkg
class.brief_description: Builds and reads archives of DirectStorage texture payloads.
class.description: [DSPkg] packages existing [code].dstex[/code] files into a [code].dspkg[/code] archive without recompressing their payloads. Use [method create], [method add_texture], and [method finalize] to build an archive. Use [method open] and the reader methods to inspect or extract entry data. The resource loader also uses [code]res://textures.dspkg[/code] for bundled texture lookups.

method.name: add_texture
method.description: Adds an existing [code].dstex[/code] file to an archive currently being built. Call [method create] first.

method.name: create
method.description: Starts building a new archive at [param output_path]. Call [method add_texture] for each entry, then call [method finalize].

method.name: finalize
method.description: Writes the archive header, entry table, and staged payloads. Returns an error if the archive is not being built or contains no textures.

method.name: get_entries
method.description: Returns an array of resource paths for all entries in the opened archive, or an empty array when no archive is open.

method.name: get_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in the opened archive.

method.name: get_entry_info
method.description: Returns metadata for an entry, including [code]archive_path[/code], [code]path[/code], [code]data_offset[/code], [code]compressed_size[/code], [code]original_size[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]pixel_format[/code], and [code]mip_count[/code].

method.name: has_texture
method.description: Returns whether the opened archive contains [param resource_path].

method.name: open
method.description: Opens and validates a [code].dspkg[/code] archive for reading. A failed open clears any previously loaded archive state.

method.name: read_texture
method.description: Reads an entry's compressed payload and metadata. The result contains [code]path[/code], [code]compressed_data[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]pixel_format[/code], [code]mip_count[/code], [code]original_size[/code], and [code]compressed_size[/code].
